log.note: rotating check 2026-10-15T21:13:21Z, 31 walks run from 329 onward in the rotation: framing-a-zoom-shows-one-box-walk failing. This is a slice, not a sweep: the rest of the set is unchecked.

Reproduced at HEAD 12fefd7a: step 17 expectCue at window (260,112) read grab, not resize. Bisected in a worktree: passes at 059cd49a, fails at d3826b57. Both open the sample at 99% zoom; on the old code adding the zoom grew the timeline (zoom lane counted in its height), the canvas refit to 75%, and the walk's window points were written against that. d3826b57 stops picks and zoom lanes from resizing the timeline ON PURPOSE, so the walk was wrong, not the app.

Walk rewritten in document points (box (16,72)-(656,472), grab at its centre, draw at (930,610), none at (1340,300) past the picture, drag BR to (789,561)), so it survives a canvas refit. Passed twice in a row on its own, every point checked in log.json against the reported handle positions.
